title: Water Tools Refurbished
description: Overhauls your survival experience with a brand new tier of aquatic equipment. Discover Water Ore, forge powerful new tools, and master the depths!
body:
Introducing the next generation of Water Tools, completely Refurbished and Refreshed! Built from the ground up with a full progression system, new materials, and a complete set of unique tools and weapons.

Experience the new yet familiar charm of water-based equipment, and enhance your gameplay with a brand-new tier of gear. Dive into a new aquatic adventure with a fully integrated survival experience!

✨ Features

A New Ore to Discover: Venture into the depths to find Water Ore, a brand-new resource that serves as the foundation for your entire aquatic arsenal.

A Full Set of Tools & Weapons: Smelt Water Ore into powerful Water Ingots and forge a complete set of equipment: the Water Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe.

New Crafting Materials: Break down Water Ingots into Water Nuggets for flexible crafting and storage.

Complete Survival Progression: Every new ore, material, and tool is fully integrated into your survival experience with unique crafting and smelting recipes.

Fully Functional Tools: All tools and weapons are designed to be balanced, durable, and a worthy upgrade in your playthrough.

Broad Mod Compatibility: Designed to work alongside your favorite mods. Fully supports Just Enough Items (JEI) for recipe viewing.
